summary: Your Marina office and Dubai wide listings are a good base, but the homepage reads like an unfinished template and gives buyers no easy way to reach an agent.

findings.problem: The area list is a raw dump of names with typos such as Sanctnary, Curreny House, Emeral Residence and Marinsacpe, and Dubai Sport City against Dubai Sports City.
findings.cost: Buyers cannot search by area, and typos look careless on a luxury brand.

findings.problem: No enquiry form or WhatsApp. The only contact is a generic Contact us email link.
findings.cost: A buyer ready to talk to an agent has no quick way to do it.
findings.fix: Enquiry form and WhatsApp on every listing.

findings.problem: The All, For Rent and For Sale tabs link to #, two Max Price filters share one label, and the footer shows the theme name (Houzez).
findings.cost: Broken filters and the theme name show a template, not a premium agency.
findings.fix: Working filters and a branded footer.

findings.problem: No team members or reviews appear, although a Meet The Team link exists, and the claim of the highest ROI in the world has no source.
findings.cost: Investors want to know who they are trusting, and unsupported claims weaken trust.
findings.fix: Agent profiles, reviews and sourced figures.

redesign: A fast property search with clean areas, plus an enquiry form and WhatsApp on every listing.
Named agent profiles, reviews and sourced market figures that win investor trust.
